Verses.VerseAr: الٓمّٓ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Alif, Lam, Mim. (Only Allah and the Messenger [blessings and peace be upon him] know the real meaning.)

Verses.VerseAr: ۚ تَنۡزِيۡلُ الۡكِتٰبِ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيۡهِ مِنۡ رَّبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: There is not even an iota of doubt in it that sending down of this Book is from the Lord of all the worlds.

Verses.VerseAr: اَمۡ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ افۡتَرٰٮهُ‌ۚ بَلۡ هُوَ الۡحَقُّ مِنۡ رَّبِّكَ لِتُنۡذِرَ قَوۡمًا مَّاۤ اَتٰٮهُمۡ مِّنۡ نَّذِيۡرٍ مِّنۡ قَبۡلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَهۡتَدُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Do the disbelievers and the polytheists say this: ‘He (the Holy Prophet) has fabricated it?’ Nay, it is the Truth from your Lord so that you may warn those to whom no Warner has come before you that they may receive guidance.

Verses.VerseAr: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِىۡ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فِىۡ سِتَّةِ اَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسۡتَوٰى عَلَى الۡعَرۡشِ‌ؕ مَا لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ مِنۡ وَّلِىٍّ وَّلَا شَفِيۡعٍ‌ؕ اَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Allah is He Who created the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them in six days (i.e. six phases). He then settled Himself on the Throne (the Command and Control System of universe). You have no helper or intercessor apart from Him. So do you not accept direction and guidance?

Verses.VerseAr: يُدَبِّرُ الۡاَمۡرَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ اِلَى الۡاَرۡضِ ثُمَّ يَعۡرُجُ اِلَيۡهِ فِىۡ يَوۡمٍ كَانَ مِقۡدَارُهٗۤ اَلۡفَ سَنَةٍ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He plans and executes (the Command and Control System) from the heavens to the earth. Then His Command ascends (and will ascend to completion) towards Him in one Day which measures one thousand years according to (the number) that you count.

Verses.VerseAr: ذٰلِكَ عٰلِمُ الۡغَيۡبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الرَّحِيۡمُۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He is the One Who knows the unseen and the visible, Almighty and Ever-Merciful.

Verses.VerseAr: الَّذِىۡۤ اَحۡسَنَ كُلَّ شَىۡءٍ خَلَقَهٗ‌ وَبَدَاَ خَلۡقَ الۡاِنۡسَانِ مِنۡ طِيۡنٍ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He is the One Who endowed everything He created with perfection and virtue. And He initiated the genesis of man from clay (i.e. inorganic matter);

Verses.VerseAr: ثُمَّ جَعَلَ نَسۡلَهٗ مِنۡ سُلٰلَةٍ مِّنۡ مَّآءٍ مَّهِيۡنٍ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then He linked up lineage of his kind from the extract of a lowly fluid (a sperm drop);

Verses.VerseAr: ثُمَّ سَوّٰٮهُ وَنَفَخَ فِيۡهِ مِنۡ رُّوۡحِهٖ‌ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمۡعَ وَالۡاَبۡصَارَ وَالۡاَفۡـِٕدَةَ  ‌ؕ قَلِيۡلاً مَّا تَشۡكُرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then He perfected (organs and limbs in) him and breathed into him of His spirit (i.e. life) and made for you (also in the mother’s womb) ears and (then) eyes and (then) hearts and brains. You give thanks but little.

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالُوۡٓا ءَاِذَا ضَلَلۡنَا فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ ءَاِنَّا لَفِىۡ خَلۡقٍ جَدِيۡدٍ‌ ؕ بَلۡ هُمۡ بِلِقَآءِ رَبِّهِمۡ كٰفِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the disbelievers say: ‘When we are lost in the earth, shall we then be created anew?’ In fact they deny the meeting with their Lord.

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ يَتَوَفّٰٮكُمۡ مَّلَكُ الۡمَوۡتِ الَّذِىۡ وُكِّلَ بِكُمۡ ثُمَّ اِلٰى رَبِّكُمۡ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘The angel of death that is appointed over you will terminate your life. Then you will be sent back to your Lord.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَوۡ تَرٰٓى اِذِ الۡمُجۡرِمُوۡنَ نَاكِسُوۡا رُءُوۡسِهِمۡ عِنۡدَ رَبِّهِمۡ رَبَّنَاۤ اَبۡصَرۡنَا وَسَمِعۡنَا فَارۡجِعۡنَا نَعۡمَلۡ صَالِحًـا اِنَّا مُوۡقِنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (you will wonder at them) if you see the sinners hanging down their heads before the Presence of their Lord (and saying:) ‘O our Lord, we have seen and heard, so send us back (to the world now) so that we do pious deeds. Surely we believe with certitude.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَوۡ شِئۡنَا لَاٰتَيۡنَا كُلَّ نَفۡسٍ هُدٰٮهَا وَلٰـكِنۡ حَقَّ الۡقَوۡلُ مِنِّىۡ لَاَمۡلَئَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ الۡجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And had We intended We would have given guidance to every soul (Ourselves), but this Command from Me has been confirmed: I will certainly fill Hell with all the (disbelieving) jinn and mankind.

Verses.VerseAr: فَذُوۡقُوۡا بِمَا نَسِيۡتُمۡ لِقَآءَ يَوۡمِكُمۡ هٰذَا‌ۚ اِنَّا نَسِيۡنٰكُمۡ‌ وَذُوۡقُوۡا عَذَابَ الۡخُلۡدِ بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So (now) savour the taste that you had forgotten your meeting of this Day. Surely We have forgotten you. And enjoy the flavour of everlasting torment, a reward of your deeds which you continued to do.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّمَا يُؤۡمِنُ بِاٰيٰتِنَا الَّذِيۡنَ اِذَا ذُكِّرُوۡا بِهَا خَرُّوۡا سُجَّدًا وَّسَبَّحُوۡا بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَهُمۡ لَا يَسۡتَكۡبِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So only those who believe in Our Revelations, when directed and guided by means of these (Verses), fall down prostrating themselves and glorify their Lord with praise. And they do not attempt arrogance.

Verses.VerseAr: تَتَجَافٰى جُنُوۡبُهُمۡ عَنِ الۡمَضَاجِعِ يَدۡعُوۡنَ رَبَّهُمۡ خَوۡفًا وَّطَمَعًا وَّمِمَّا رَزَقۡنٰهُمۡ يُنۡفِقُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Their sides stay away from their beds and they call out to their Lord in a (mingled state) of fear and hope and spend (in Our Way) out of the sustenance We have provided them.

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَا تَعۡلَمُ نَفۡسٌ مَّاۤ اُخۡفِىَ لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ قُرَّةِ اَعۡيُنٍ‌ۚ جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So no one knows what coolness of eyes is kept hidden for them. This will be a reward for those (pious deeds) which they used to do.

Verses.VerseAr: اَفَمَنۡ كَانَ مُؤۡمِنًا كَمَنۡ كَانَ فَاسِقًا‌ؕ لَّا يَسۡتَوٗنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: How can a person who is a believer be like him who is disobedient? (Nay,) they (both) cannot be equal.

Verses.VerseAr: اَمَّا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوۡا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ جَنّٰتُ الۡمَاۡوٰى نُزُلاًۢ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So those who believe and keep doing good deeds, for them are Gardens of eternal repose as an entertainment and honour (from their Lord) in reward for those (works) which they used to do.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَمَّا الَّذِيۡنَ فَسَقُوۡا فَمَاۡوٰٮهُمُ النَّارُ‌ؕ كُلَّمَاۤ اَرَادُوۡۤا اَنۡ يَّخۡرُجُوۡا مِنۡهَاۤ اُعِيۡدُوۡا فِيۡهَا وَقِيۡلَ لَهُمۡ ذُوۡقُوۡا عَذَابَ النَّارِ الَّذِىۡ كُنۡتُمۡ بِهٖ تُكَذِّبُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: But as for those who disobeyed, their abode is Hell. Every time they will intend to get out of it and escape, they will be turned back into it and it will be said to them: ‘Keep enjoying the taste of this Fire of Hell which you used to belie.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَنــُذِيۡقَنَّهُمۡ مِّنَ الۡعَذَابِ الۡاَدۡنٰى دُوۡنَ الۡعَذَابِ الۡاَكۡبَرِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And surely before the major torment (of the Hereafter), We shall make them savour the (taste of) nearby torment (in this world) so that they abstain (from disbelief).

Words.MeaningEn: And surely, We will let them taste

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَنۡ اَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنۡ ذُكِّرَ بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهٖ ثُمَّ اَعۡرَضَ عَنۡهَا‌ؕ اِنَّا مِنَ الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ مُنۡتَقِمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And who is a greater wrongdoer than someone who is admonished by means of Revelations of His Lord, and then he turns away from them? Surely We take revenge on the evildoers.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا مُوۡسَى الۡكِتٰبَ فَلَا تَكُنۡ فِىۡ مِرۡيَةٍ مِّنۡ لِّقَآٮِٕهٖ‌ وَجَعَلۡنٰهُ هُدًى لِّبَنِىۡۤ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And verily We gave Musa (Moses) the Book (Torah). So do not have any doubt with regard to his meeting. (That meeting is about to take place during the Night of the Ascension.) And We made it a guidance for the Children of Israel.

Verses.VerseAr: وَجَعَلۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ اَٮِٕمَّةً يَّهۡدُوۡنَ بِاَمۡرِنَا لَمَّا صَبَرُوۡا‌ؕ وَكَانُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا يُوۡقِنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We made from among them authorities and leaders who kept disseminating guidance by Our Command when they persevered with patience. And they believed in Our Revelations with certitude.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَفۡصِلُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ فِيۡمَا كَانُوۡا فِيۡهِ يَخۡتَلِفُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely your Lord alone will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning matters in which they used to disagree.

Verses.VerseAr: اَوَلَمۡ يَهۡدِ لَهُمۡ كَمۡ اَهۡلَكۡنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡ مِّنَ الۡقُرُوۡنِ يَمۡشُوۡنَ فِىۡ مَسٰكِنِهِمۡ‌ؕ اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍؕ اَفَلَا يَسۡمَعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And have they not taken any guidance (from this proclamation) that how many generations We have destroyed before them in whose dwellings these people (now) move about? Surely there are Signs in it. So do they not hear?

Verses.VerseAr: اَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا اَنَّا نَسُوۡقُ الۡمَآءَ اِلَى الۡاَرۡضِ الۡجُرُزِ فَنُخۡرِجُ بِهٖ زَرۡعًا تَاۡكُلُ مِنۡهُ اَنۡعَامُهُمۡ وَاَنۡفُسُهُمۡ‌ؕ اَفَلَا يُبۡصِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And have they not seen that We stream water towards the dry land, then with that We produce crops of which their cattle as well as they themselves eat? Do they not observe?

Verses.VerseAr: وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ مَتٰى هٰذَا الۡفَتۡحُ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they say: ‘When will this (Day of) Judgment take place if you are truthful?’

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ يَوۡمَ الۡفَتۡحِ لَا يَنۡفَعُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡۤا اِيۡمَانُهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنۡظَرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘On the Day of Judgment the belief of disbelievers will bring them no benefit, nor will they be given any respite.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَعۡرِضۡ عَنۡهُمۡ وَانتَظِرۡ اِنَّهُمۡ مُّنۡتَظِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So turn your face away from them and wait and they (too) are waiting.
